---
title: "Coding agents"
toc: false
---

The single source of truth for humans and coding agents (Copilot, Claude,
Cursor, Hermes, etc.) working on Kailash OS is
[`AGENTS.md`](https://github.com/kailash-os/kailash-os/blob/master/AGENTS.md)
in the [`kailash-os`](https://github.com/kailash-os/kailash-os) repository
(default branch `master`). The companion guide for the
[`kailash-packages`](https://github.com/kailash-os/kailash-packages) overlay
repo is
[`AGENTS.md`](https://github.com/kailash-os/kailash-packages/blob/main/AGENTS.md)
there. Tool-specific files (`CLAUDE.md`,
`.github/copilot-instructions.md`) point at these; when anything disagrees,
**AGENTS.md wins**.

Read them at the source — the GitHub-rendered pages are always current:

- [`kailash-os`](https://github.com/kailash-os/kailash-os/blob/master/AGENTS.md):
  project map, layer model and the manifest single-home rule, TDD standard
  with the layer map, the ADR process
  ([`docs/adr/`](https://github.com/kailash-os/kailash-os/tree/master/docs/adr)),
  PR contract, labels, security rules (the distribution packages offensive
  tooling — the safety posture is deliberate and testable).
- [`kailash-packages`](https://github.com/kailash-os/kailash-packages/blob/main/AGENTS.md):
  the overlay flake — pins, packaging shapes and the manifest rules that
  every other artifact generates from.

This page intentionally does not mirror either file: a mirror drifts the
moment the repos move, and the source-of-truth rule (AGENTS.md wins)
already says where to look.
